meta.title: Services & pricing · Geneva & Annecy | Cosmic Studio
meta.description: Showcase sites, online shops, apps and ongoing care, with prices on display: a subscription from {price} a month excl. VAT, or a quoted project.

intro.title: A site that runs, and someone who looks after it.
intro.lead: Our prices are on display, so you know straight away whether it fits your budget, without asking for a quote. And it all starts with a free mockup, with no commitment.

simulator.title: Start simple, add the rest later.
simulator.lead: Two plans: “We take care of everything”, from {price} a month excl. VAT, or “You stay in control”, from {selfServicePrice} a month excl. VAT, if you want to publish your news yourself. Tick the options you want to see the monthly price.

showcase.title: Showcase sites
showcase.description: To present your business, your work and your opening hours, and be found on Google by people nearby.

shops.title: Shops & bookings
shops.description: To sell online, take appointments or manage memberships, with no commission on your sales.

apps.title: Apps
apps.description: A tool for your team, an app for your customers or members, an assistant that answers frequent questions, on the web or on a phone.

care.title: Visibility & care
care.description: Google visibility, hosting, backups, updates and changes, with one person to contact who knows your site.

ownership.question: Do I own the site?
ownership.answer: Your texts, images and domain name belong to you from day one. The site's code is transferred to you after {months} months of subscription, which is what lets us keep the starting price this low. You can also take it over earlier, for a transfer fee based on the remaining time. For a quoted project, the code is yours on delivery.

edit.question: Can I edit the site myself?
edit.answer: Yes, with the “You stay in control” plan: you publish your news and change your opening hours yourself from a simple editing space, and we show you how to use it. If you would rather leave it all to us, the “We take care of everything” plan is enough: you email us your changes, and we put them online.

timing.question: How long until I am online?
timing.answer: Allow two to three weeks for a showcase page, from the moment we have your texts and photos, and four to six weeks for a five-page site. We set a launch date at the start and we stick to it.

stop.question: What happens if I stop?
stop.answer: Just let us know: the site stays online until the end of the period already paid, and you leave with your content and your domain name. The code is transferred to you free of charge after {months} months of subscription; before that, it is transferred for a fee we tell you about from the start. If your subscription includes a domain name, an email address, the “You stay in control” plan or an option marked “1-year commitment”, it runs in 12-month periods, and the current period runs to its end.

content.question: Do you also write the texts and take the photos?
content.answer: We help you write and we proofread everything, keeping in mind the words your customers type into Google. For photos and videos, we use yours, or have them made on a quote by a local professional, and we handle the relationship with them.

cta.title: Let's talk about your site.
cta.description: Tell us about your business in a few lines. We reply quickly, then prepare your free mockup if you would like one.
